info.name: Back Market - API Guidelines Care API
Get a list of Care Folders attached to a Seller

params.name: last_id
params.description: Retrieve Care Folders with an ID higher than `last_id`

params.name: state
params.description:
Retrieve Care Folders with state equal to `state`.
  * 0 - OPEN
  * 9 - CLOSED

params.name: orderline
params.description: Retrieve Care Folders for a specific Orderline

params.name: last_modification_date
params.description: Retrieve Care Folders more recent than `last_modification_date`. Format is YYYY-MM-DD-hh-mm

params.name: last_message_date
params.description: Retrieve Care Folders having messages more recent than `last_message_date`. Format is YYYY-MM-DD-hh-mm

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (10 entries per page).

items.docs:
## Rate Limiting

This endpoint is rate limited to 520 requests per minute and 4000 per day.
If you exceed this limit, you will receive a `429` status code.

info.name: Declare a problem on a Care Folder

params.name: careFolderId
params.description: ID of the Care Folder on which the problem is declared

items.docs:
Declare a problem on a Care Folder.

The `problem_type` field specifies the type of problem. If omitted, it defaults to `OTHER`.

Attachments are **mandatory** for the following problem types: `DAMAGED_PACKAGE`, `ITEM_NOT_RECEIVED`, `OOW_ITEM`.

For Care Folders with ID below 100,000,000, only `OTHER` is accepted and no message or attachments can be provided.
